# ranking-shapes fixture

Synthetic, fictional corpus for the ranking-shape bench. Generated by `scripts/bench/ranking-shapes/generate.ts` (seed 154). Do not hand-edit; rerun the generator.

```json
{
  "pages": 208,
  "source_a": 178,
  "source_b": 30,
  "questions": 70,
  "shapes": {
    "E2": 6,
    "E4": 6,
    "E15": 21,
    "E1": 23,
    "E13": 2,
    "E11": 4,
    "E3": 4,
    "E9": 4
  },
  "longest_body_chars": 60285,
  "llm": {
    "model": "gpt-4.1-mini"
  },
  "privacy_findings": 0
}
```

- `source-a/`, `source-b/`: page directories (source-b holds same-slug twins plus a few b-only pages).
- `questions.jsonl`: one row per question; `related` lists the stub/family/founder/image pages that the shape-specific pass criteria look at.
- `manifest.json`: slug to role map.
